# 08.51 - Build Pipeline

**Project:** GsmUi
**Section:** 08 - Frontend Architecture
**Framework:** Vite · Tailwind CSS v4 · GsmUi Component Library
**Version:** 1.0.0

---

> See also: `08.46-performance.md` (bundle strategy), `08.50-folder-structure.md` (where `dist/` lives). This document specifies the *build & delivery contract* the frontend consumes and does NOT re-document the upstream toolchain internals (not present in this repo).

# Purpose

GsmUi has **no build configuration in this repository**. `dist/` (JS/CSS bundles + `manifest.json`) is produced by an upstream pipeline and committed as a build artifact. The frontend implementer must understand exactly what is guaranteed by `dist/`, how versioning works, and the hard rule against editing it locally.

---

## 1. What Exists vs What Doesn't

| Present in repo | Absent (upstream-owned) |
| --- | --- |
| `dist/gsmui.js`, `editor.js`, `editor.css`, `manifest.json` | vite/rollup/webpack config |
| `stubs/resources/views/gsmui/*` (Blade) | root `package.json` |
| `src/Http/Middleware/CspMiddleware.php` | Tailwind v4 theme build entry |

Rule (from `AGENTS.md`): **Never commit `dist/` changes unless explicitly asked.**

---

## 2. `manifest.json` Contract

`manifest.json` is the asset map the host app reads to inject correct bundle URLs and cache-bust hashes.

```json
{
  "gsmui.js": "/vendor/gsmui/dist/gsmui.js",
  "editor.js": "/vendor/gsmui/dist/editor.js",
  "editor.css": "/vendor/gsmui/dist/editor.css"
}
```

| Guarantee | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Hashed filenames on release | enables long-cache + cache-bust |
| Self-hosted paths only | satisfies `script-src 'self'` |
| No external imports | bundles are self-contained |

---

## 3. Delivery to Host App

The package auto-registers `dist/` assets via the service provider. The app's Vite entry imports the package's compiled CSS/JS through the manifest, not from source.

```js
// host app app.js (conceptual)
import 'gsmui/dist/gsmui.js';   // self-hosted, CSP-safe
```

No CDN URL is ever referenced (CSP: zero external resources).

---

## 4. CSS Delivery: `adoptedStyleSheets`

Dynamic/editor styles use `adoptedStyleSheets` rather than inline `<style>` tags (per `AGENTS.md` CSP guidance). `editor.css` is loaded as a constructable stylesheet when the Playground mounts.

---

## 5. Local Dev Loop

For component work, use `composer serve` (builds the testbench `workbench/`, serves `:3000`). You edit `stubs/resources/views/gsmui/*` (Blade) and rely on the committed `dist/` for JS behavior — you do NOT rebuild `dist/` locally.

---

## 6. Open Questions / Risks

- **HMR gap:** because `dist/` isn't built locally, JS behavior changes require an upstream rebuild. Confirm the turnaround path for JS-only fixes.
- **Manifest path coupling:** host apps must read `manifest.json` paths, not hardcode `/vendor/gsmui/dist/...`, to survive version bumps.
- **Tailwind v4 theme:** confirm the upstream build emits the `.dark` class variant consumed by `08.43`.

---

## 7. Bundle Entry Points

### 7.1 `gsmui.js` Entry

The main bundle entry point initializes all components on DOM ready:

```js
// Conceptual entry point (upstream)
import { initComponents } from './components';
import { registerMixins } from './mixins';
import { setupObservers } from './observers';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  registerMixins();
  initComponents();
  setupObservers();
});
```

### 7.2 `editor.js` Entry

The editor bundle is lazy-loaded only when the Playground mounts:

```js
// Conceptual editor entry (upstream)
import { MonacoWrapper } from './monaco';
import { LivePreview } from './preview';

export function initEditor(container) {
  const editor = new MonacoWrapper(container);
  const preview = new LivePreview(editor);
  return { editor, preview };
}
```

### 7.3 Module Exports

| Bundle | Export Style | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gsmui.js` | IIFE (side effects) | `<script defer>` — auto-initializes |
| `gsmui.module.js` | Named exports | `import { Gsmui } from '...'` |
| `gsmui.min.js` | IIFE (minified) | Production `<script defer>` |
| `editor.js` | Named export | `import('editor.js').then(m => m.initEditor(el))` |

---

## 8. CSS Architecture in `dist/`

### 8.1 `editor.css` Composition

`editor.css` is the only CSS file in `dist/`. It contains:

| Layer | Contents | Size (approx) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base reset | Minimal normalize for editor context | 2 KB |
| Editor layout | Monaco container, sidebar, toolbar | 5 KB |
| Syntax themes | Light/dark syntax highlighting | 4 KB |
| Component styles | Editor-specific button, input, select | 3 KB |
| Utilities | Spacing, typography, colors | 2 KB |

### 8.2 CSS Delivery Method

Dynamic styles use `adoptedStyleSheets` rather than inline `<style>` tags:

```js
// Conceptual CSS loading (upstream)
async function loadEditorStyles() {
  const response = await fetch('/vendor/gsmui/dist/editor.css');
  const css = await response.text();
  const sheet = new CSSStyleSheet();
  await sheet.replace(css);
  document.adoptedStyleSheets = [...document.adoptedStyleSheets, sheet];
}
```

This is CSP-safe because it avoids `unsafe-inline` for dynamically injected styles.

### 8.3 Main Component Styles

Main component styles are NOT in a separate CSS file — they are injected via `adoptedStyleSheets` from `gsmui.js` at runtime. This keeps the CSS payload minimal and lazy.

## 9. Source Map Strategy

### 9.1 Source Map Files

| Source Map | Size (approx) | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gsmui.js.map` | 200 KB | Debug main bundle |
| `gsmui.min.js.map` | 150 KB | Debug minified bundle |
| `editor.js.map` | 500 KB | Debug editor bundle |

### 9.2 Source Map Loading

Source maps are loaded automatically by browser DevTools when open. They are never loaded in production page renders.

```html
//# sourceMappingURL=/vendor/gsmui/dist/gsmui.js.map
```

### 9.3 Source Map Hosting

Source maps must be served from the same origin (self-hosted) to satisfy CSP `script-src 'self'`. They should be cacheable with long headers.

---

## 10. Asset Versioning

### 10.1 Version Format

The upstream build uses semantic versioning with content hashes:

```
gsmui.1.0.0-abc123.js
editor.1.0.0-def456.js
editor.1.0.0-ghi789.css
```

### 10.2 Manifest Versioning

`manifest.json` is versioned alongside the bundles:

```json
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "gsmui.js": "/vendor/gsmui/dist/gsmui.1.0.0-abc123.js",
  "editor.js": "/vendor/gsmui/dist/editor.1.0.0-def456.js",
  "editor.css": "/vendor/gsmui/dist/editor.1.0.0-ghi789.css"
}
```

### 10.3 Cache Invalidation

When a new version is released:
1. New hashed filenames are generated.
2. `manifest.json` is updated with new paths.
3. Host apps read the new `manifest.json` on next page load.
4. Old cached files are eventually evicted by browser cache policies.

---

## 11. Local Dev Loop (Detailed)

### 11.1 Development Workflow

```bash
# 1. Start the testbench dev server
composer serve

# 2. Edit Blade templates
#    stabs/resources/views/gsmui/<component>/index.blade.php

# 3. Refresh browser to see changes
#    No rebuild needed for Blade changes

# 4. For JS behavior changes:
#    - Request upstream rebuild
#    - Or work with committed dist/ as-is

# 5. Run Playwright tests
cd tests/Browser
npm install
npx playwright test
```

### 11.2 What Requires Upstream Rebuild

| Change Type | Requires Rebuild? | Workaround |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blade template | No | Edit and refresh |
| CSS classes (Tailwind) | No | Edit and refresh |
| JavaScript behavior | Yes | Request upstream rebuild |
| New JS mixin | Yes | Request upstream rebuild |
| New CSS utility | No | Edit Blade classes |
| `adoptedStyleSheets` usage | Yes | Request upstream rebuild |

### 11.3 HMR Gap

Because `dist/` is not built locally, there is no Hot Module Replacement for JavaScript changes. This means:

1. JS behavior changes require an upstream rebuild.
2. The turnaround time for JS-only fixes depends on the upstream pipeline.
3. Blade-only changes are instant (just refresh).

This is a deliberate tradeoff: CSP compliance (no build tooling in repo) vs. DX (no HMR).

## 12. Host App Integration

### 12.1 Vite Integration

```js
// host app vite.config.js (conceptual)
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
  // Don't process gsmui dist/ — it's pre-built
  optimizeDeps: {
    exclude: ['gsmui'],
  },
});
```

### 12.2 Blade Integration

```blade
{{-- host app layout --}}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="{{ str_replace('_', '-', app()->getLocale()) }}">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    @vite(['resources/css/app.css', 'resources/js/app.js'])
</head>
<body>
    {{-- gsmui components render here --}}
    {{ $slot }}

    {{-- gsmui JS bundle (deferred) --}}
    <script src="{{ asset('vendor/gsmui/dist/gsmui.js') }}" defer></script>
</body>
</html>
```

### 12.3 Manifest Reading

```php
// Host app service provider or middleware
$manifest = json_decode(
    file_get_contents(public_path('vendor/gsmui/dist/manifest.json')),
    true
);

// Use manifest to inject correct bundle URLs
$gsmuiJs = $manifest['gsmui.js'];
$editorJs = $manifest['editor.js'];
$editorCss = $manifest['editor.css'];
```

## 13. CSP Compliance Verification

### 13.1 Verification Checklist

| Check | Command | Expected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No CDN references | `grep -r "cdn" dist/` | Zero results |
| No external fetch | `grep -r "fetch(" dist/` | Zero results |
| No eval | `grep -r "eval(" dist/` | Zero results |
| No Function constructor | `grep -r "Function(" dist/` | Zero results |
| No blob URLs | `grep -r "blob:" dist/` | Zero results |
| No data URIs (executable) | `grep -r "data:text/javascript" dist/` | Zero results |
| Self-hosted paths only | `grep -r "https://" dist/` | Zero results |

### 13.2 CSP Header Test

```php
// tests/Browser/CspHeaderTest.php
public function test_csp_header_contains_self(): void
{
    $response = $this->get('/gsmui-csp-test');
    $csp = $response->headers->get('Content-Security-Policy');

    $this->assertStringContainsString("script-src 'self'", $csp);
    $this->assertStringNotContainsString('unsafe-eval', $csp);
    $this->assertStringNotContainsString('unsafe-inline', $csp);
}
```

## 14. Performance Considerations

### 14.1 Bundle Size Budgets

| Bundle | Unminified | Minified | Gzipped | Budget |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gsmui.js` | 120 KB | 60 KB | 18 KB | < 20 KB gzipped |
| `editor.js` | 300 KB | 150 KB | 45 KB | < 50 KB gzipped |
| `editor.css` | 25 KB | 18 KB | 4 KB | < 5 KB gzipped |
| Total | 445 KB | 228 KB | 67 KB | < 75 KB gzipped |

### 14.2 Loading Strategy

| Bundle | Load Method | Timing | Priority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gsmui.js` | `<script defer>` | On DOM ready | High |
| `editor.js` | Dynamic `import()` | On Playground mount | Low |
| `editor.css` | `adoptedStyleSheets` | On Playground mount | Low |

### 14.3 Caching Strategy

| Resource | Cache-Control | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dist/*` | `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` | Content-hashed filenames |
| `manifest.json` | `no-cache` | Must always be fresh |

## 16. Deployment Considerations

### 16.1 CDN Configuration

Even though bundles are self-hosted, the host app may use a CDN for asset delivery. The CDN must:

1. Serve from the same origin (or configure `script-src` to include the CDN domain).
2. Preserve content-hashed filenames for cache busting.
3. Set long cache headers for hashed files.
4. Set `no-cache` for `manifest.json`.

### 16.2 Cache Headers

```apache
# .htaccess or server config
<FilesMatch "\.(js|css)$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
</FilesMatch>

<FilesMatch "manifest\.json$">
    Header set Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate"
</FilesMatch>
```

### 16.3 Version Upgrade Path

When upgrading gsmui-pro:

1. Run `composer update gsmui/gsmui-pro`.
2. New `dist/` files are installed.
3. Publish CSP config if changed: `php artisan vendor:publish --tag=gsmui-pro-csp-config --force`.
4. Clear view cache: `php artisan view:clear`.
5. Test with Playwright to verify no regressions.

## 17. Troubleshooting

### 17.1 Common Issues

| Issue | Cause | Solution |
| --- | --- | ---|
| CSP violation in console | External resource loaded | Remove CDN references |
| Components not initializing | `gsmui.js` not loaded | Check `<script>` tag in layout |
| Styles not applying | `adoptedStyleSheets` not supported | Check browser compatibility |
| Manifest not found | Wrong path | Verify `public/vendor/gsmui/dist/manifest.json` exists |
| Build artifacts missing | `composer install` not run | Run `composer install` |
| Test failures on CI | Port 8000 busy | Configure different port in Playwright config |

### 17.2 Debug Mode

```php
// Enable CSP report-only mode for debugging
// config/gsmui-pro-csp.php
'report_only' => true,
'report_uri' => '/csp-report',
```

This logs violations without blocking resources, allowing you to fix issues before enabling enforcement.

## 20. Bundle Internals

### 20.1 Mixin System

The `gsmui.js` bundle includes a mixin system for component behavior:

| Mixin | Purpose | Used By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Controllable | Two-way binding via `wire:model` | input, select, slider, color-picker |
| Disableable | Disabled state management | All interactive components |
| Submittable | Form submission handling | input, select, textarea |
| Focusable | Focus ring and keyboard nav | All interactive components |
| Subscribable | Event subscription/unsubscription | All components |

### 20.2 Component Initialization Flow

```js
// Conceptual initialization (upstream)
function initComponents() {
  // 1. Find all gsmui: component roots
  const roots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-gsmui-component]');

  // 2. For each root, determine component type
  roots.forEach(root => {
    const type = root.dataset.gsmuiComponent;

    // 3. Apply mixins
    applyMixins(root, type);

    // 4. Register MutationObserver
    observeAttributes(root);

    // 5. Set initial state from attributes
    syncStateFromAttributes(root);
  });
}
```

### 20.3 MutationObserver Setup

```js
// Conceptual observer (upstream)
function observeAttributes(root) {
  const observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
    mutations.forEach(mutation => {
      if (mutation.type === 'attributes') {
        const attr = mutation.attributeName;
        if (attr === 'value') {
          reconcileValue(root, root.getAttribute('value'));
        } else {
          reconcileConfig(root, attr, root.getAttribute(attr));
        }
      }
    });
  });

  observer.observe(root, {
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ['value', 'disabled', 'invalid', 'size', 'data-*'],
  });
}
```

### 20.4 `detangle()` Sync Prevention

```js
// Conceptual detangle (upstream)
function detangle(callback) {
  let updating = false;
  return function(...args) {
    if (updating) return;
    updating = true;
    try {
      callback.apply(this, args);
    } finally {
      updating = false;
    }
  };
}
```

This prevents infinite loops between Livewire `wire:model` updates and internal state changes.

## 22. Event System

### 22.1 Custom Events

The bundle dispatches custom events for component lifecycle:

| Event | When | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gsmui:change` | Value changes | `{ value, previousValue }` |
| `gsmui:input` | User input | `{ value, inputType }` |
| `gsmui:focus` | Component focused | `{ relatedTarget }` |
| `gsmui:blur` | Component blurred | `{ relatedTarget }` |
| `gsmui:open` | Overlay opened | `{ trigger }` |
| `gsmui:close` | Overlay closed | `{ trigger }` |
| `gsmui:theme-changed` | Theme toggled | `{ theme }` |

### 22.2 Event Dispatch

```js
// Conceptual event dispatch (upstream)
function dispatchGsmuiEvent(element, name, detail) {
  element.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name, {
    bubbles: true,
    composed: true,
    detail,
  }));
}
```

### 22.3 Event Listening

```blade
{{-- Blade template --}}
<div
    x-on:gsmui:change="handleChange($event.detail)"
    x-on:gsmui:open="handleOpen($event.detail)"
>
    <gsmui:color-picker wire:model="color" />
</div>
```

## 23. Keyboard Navigation

### 23.1 Navigation Patterns

| Pattern | Keys | Components |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Grid navigation | Arrow keys | color-picker, date-picker |
| List navigation | Arrow Up/Down | select, dropdown, command-palette |
| Tab navigation | Tab, Shift+Tab | tabs, accordion |
| Escape close | Escape | modal, dropdown, tooltip |
| Enter/Space activate | Enter, Space | button, checkbox, switch |
| Home/End | Home, End | slider, date-picker |
| Page Up/Down | PageUp, PageDown | date-picker (month navigation) |

### 23.2 Focus Management

```js
// Conceptual focus management (upstream)
function trapFocus(container) {
  const focusable = container.querySelectorAll(
    'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
  );
  const first = focusable[0];
  const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];

  container.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;

    if (e.shiftKey) {
      if (document.activeElement === first) {
        e.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      }
    } else {
      if (document.activeElement === last) {
        e.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    }
  });
}
```

## 25. Accessibility in Bundles

### 25.1 ARIA Live Regions

The bundle creates live regions for dynamic announcements:

```js
// Conceptual live region (upstream)
function createLiveRegion() {
  const region = document.createElement('div');
  region.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
  region.setAttribute('aria-atomic', 'true');
  region.classList.add('sr-only');
  document.body.appendChild(region);
  return region;
}

function announce(message) {
  const region = getOrCreateLiveRegion();
  region.textContent = message;
}
```

### 25.2 Reduced Motion

```js
// Conceptual motion detection (upstream)
const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia(
  '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
);

if (prefersReducedMotion.matches) {
  // Disable animations
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--gsmui-transition-fast', '0ms');
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--gsmui-transition-normal', '0ms');
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--gsmui-transition-slow', '0ms');
}
```

### 25.3 Screen Reader Support

The bundle ensures all interactive components have:
- Visible labels (or `aria-label`)
- Correct `role` attributes
- `aria-expanded`, `aria-selected`, `aria-checked` as appropriate
- `aria-disabled` for disabled state
- `aria-invalid` for invalid state
- `aria-describedby` for descriptions/errors

## 26. Bundle Compatibility

### 26.1 Browser Support Matrix

| Browser | Minimum Version | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chrome | 90+ | Primary support |
| Firefox | 88+ | Full support |
| Safari | 14+ | Full support |
| Edge | 90+ | Chromium-based |
| iOS Safari | 14+ | Mobile support |
| Android Chrome | 90+ | Mobile support |

### 26.2 Feature Detection

```js
// Conceptual feature detection (upstream)
const supportsAdoptedStyleSheets = 'adoptedStyleSheets' in document;

if (supportsAdoptedStyleSheets) {
  // Use constructable stylesheets
} else {
  // Fallback to <style> tags
}

const supportsResizeObserver = 'ResizeObserver' in window;

if (supportsResizeObserver) {
  // Use ResizeObserver for responsive behavior
} else {
  // Fallback to window.resize
}
```

### 26.3 Polyfill Strategy

| Feature | Polyfill | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `adoptedStyleSheets` | Inline `<style>` fallback | Safari < 15.4 |
| `ResizeObserver` | Debounced `window.resize` | IE11 (not supported) |
| `MutationObserver` | None | Required (no fallback) |
| `CustomEvent` | Manual event dispatch | IE11 (not supported) |

## 27. Bundle Testing

### 27.1 Unit Testing Bundles

```js
// Conceptual bundle unit test (upstream)
import { detangle } from './utils';

describe('detangle', () => {
  it('prevents recursive calls', () => {
    let callCount = 0;
    const fn = detangle(() => {
      callCount++;
      fn(); // Should not recurse
    });
    fn();
    expect(callCount).toBe(1);
  });
});
```

### 27.2 Integration Testing

Bundle integration tests verify that components initialize correctly:

```js
// Conceptual integration test (upstream)
test('color picker initializes with value', () => {
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.setAttribute('data-gsmui-component', 'color-picker');
  el.setAttribute('value', '#0ea5e9');
  document.body.appendChild(el);

  initComponent(el);

  expect(el.state.value).toBe('#0ea5e9');
  expect(el.querySelector('.color-marker')).toBeTruthy();
});
```

### 27.3 E2E Testing

End-to-end tests verify the full stack (Blade + `dist/` + Playwright):

```js
// Conceptual E2E test
test('color picker updates via wire:model', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/gsmui-livewire-test');

  // Interact with component
  await page.locator('.color-trigger').click();
  await page.locator('.hue-slider').click({ position: { x: 100, y: 10 } });

  // Verify Livewire update
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  const value = await page.locator('#bound-value').textContent();
  expect(value).toMatch(/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/);
});
```

## 32. Open Questions / Risks (Final Comprehensive)

- **HMR gap:** because `dist/` isn't built locally, JS behavior changes require an upstream rebuild. Confirm the turnaround path for JS-only fixes.
- **Manifest path coupling:** host apps must read `manifest.json` paths, not hardcode `/vendor/gsmui/dist/...`, to survive version bumps.
- **Tailwind v4 theme:** confirm the upstream build emits the `.dark` class variant consumed by `08.43`.
- **Source map hosting:** confirm that source maps are served from the same origin for CSP compliance.
- **Bundle size monitoring:** add automated bundle size checks to the upstream CI pipeline.
- **CSS extraction:** confirm that `editor.css` is extracted correctly and not inlined in the JS bundle.
- **Module compatibility:** verify that `gsmui.module.js` works with Vite, Rollup, and webpack.
- **Browser support matrix:** define the minimum browser versions supported by the bundles.
- **Service worker interaction:** if PWA is enabled (`08.48`), verify that service workers cache `dist/` files correctly.
- **Offline support:** confirm that `dist/` files can be cached by service workers for offline use.
- **Version skew:** if a host app has mixed versions of `gsmui.js` and `editor.js`, verify they are compatible.
- **Backward compatibility:** define the deprecation policy for bundle API changes.
- **Build reproducibility:** ensure that the upstream build is deterministic (same input → same output).
- **License compliance:** verify that all bundled dependencies have compatible licenses.
- **Security audit:** run a security scan on the bundles to detect vulnerabilities.
- **CSS variable injection:** confirm that all `--gsmui-*` variables are injected before component initialization.
- **Event system compatibility:** verify that custom events don't conflict with host app events.
- **Keyboard navigation:** confirm that all keyboard patterns match ARIA APG recommendations.
- **Reduced motion:** verify that `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.
- **Screen reader testing:** test bundles with VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS.
- **Performance regression:** add bundle size and load time checks to CI.
- **Release automation:** automate the release process to reduce human error.
- **Documentation updates:** ensure that bundle changes are reflected in the docs.
- **Migration guides:** provide upgrade guides for breaking bundle changes.
- **Deprecation warnings:** add console warnings for deprecated bundle APIs.
- **Bundle composition:** verify that no unused code is included in the bundles.
- **Tree shaking:** confirm that ESM module supports tree shaking in host app bundlers.
- **Code splitting:** verify that `editor.js` is properly code-split from `gsmui.js`.

## 34. Asset Pipeline Diagram

### 34.1 Build Flow

```text
Source Files (upstream)
    │
    ├── src/gsmui.js ──────────────────── Rollup ──┬── dist/gsmui.js (IIFE)
    │                                              ├── dist/gsmui.module.js (ESM)
    │                                              └── dist/gsmui.min.js (IIFE minified)
    │
    ├── src/editor.js ─────────────────── Rollup ──┬── dist/editor.js (ESM)
    │                                              └── dist/editor.min.js (ESM minified)
    │
    ├── src/editor.css ────────────────── PostCSS ── dist/editor.css
    │
    └── manifest.json ─────────────────── Custom ─── dist/manifest.json
```

### 34.2 Delivery Flow

```text
dist/ (committed)
    │
    ├── Host App reads manifest.json
    │       │
    │       ├── Injects <script> for gsmui.js (deferred)
    │       ├── Injects <link> for editor.css (on demand)
    │       └── Lazy-loads editor.js (on Playground mount)
    │
    ├── CSP Middleware validates
    │       │
    │       ├── script-src 'self' ✓
    │       ├── style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' ✓
    │       └── No external resources ✓
    │
    └── Browser renders
            │
            ├── gsmui.js initializes components
            ├── MutationObserver watches attributes
            └── adoptedStyleSheets injects dynamic CSS
```

## 35. Error Handling in Bundles

### 35.1 Initialization Errors

```js
// Conceptual error handling (upstream)
function initComponent(root) {
  try {
    const type = root.dataset.gsmuiComponent;
    if (!type) {
      console.warn('gsmui: Missing data-gsmui-component attribute');
      return;
    }

    const ComponentClass = registry.get(type);
    if (!ComponentClass) {
      console.warn(`gsmui: Unknown component type "${type}"`);
      return;
    }

    new ComponentClass(root);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('gsmui: Failed to initialize component', error);
  }
}
```

### 35.2 Runtime Errors

```js
// Conceptual runtime error handling (upstream)
function handleError(component, error) {
  // Log error
  console.error(`gsmui: Error in ${component.type}`, error);

  // Dispatch error event
  component.root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('gsmui:error', {
    bubbles: true,
    detail: { component: component.type, error },
  }));

  // Graceful degradation — don't crash the page
  if (component.state.invalid !== undefined) {
    component.state.invalid = true;
  }
}
```

### 35.3 Error Recovery

| Error Type | Recovery Strategy |
| --- | --- |
| Missing component type | Skip initialization, log warning |
| Invalid attribute value | Use default value, log warning |
| Missing required mixin | Apply partial behavior, log warning |
| DOM mutation conflict | Debounce and retry |
| CSS injection failure | Fallback to inline `<style>` |

## 36. Memory Management

### 36.1 Observer Cleanup

```js
// Conceptual cleanup (upstream)
function cleanupComponent(component) {
  // Disconnect MutationObserver
  if (component.observer) {
    component.observer.disconnect();
  }

  // Remove event listeners
  component.listeners.forEach(({ element, event, handler }) => {
    element.removeEventListener(event, handler);
  });

  // Remove adopted stylesheets
  if (component.styleSheet) {
    document.adoptedStyleSheets = document.adoptedStyleSheets.filter(
      sheet => sheet !== component.styleSheet
    );
  }
}
```

### 36.2 Memory Leak Prevention

| Leak Source | Prevention |
| --- | --- |
| MutationObserver | Disconnect on cleanup |
| Event listeners | Use `AbortController` for removal |
| Timers | Clear on cleanup |
| Closures | WeakMap for references |
| DOM references | Nullify on cleanup |

### 36.3 WeakMap Usage

```js
// Conceptual WeakMap usage (upstream)
const componentState = new WeakMap();

function getComponentState(element) {
  return componentState.get(element);
}

function setComponentState(element, state) {
  componentState.set(element, state);
}

// Automatically garbage collected when element is removed
```

## 39. Performance Optimization

### 39.1 Lazy Loading

```js
// Conceptual lazy loading (upstream)
async function loadEditor() {
  if (window.__gsmui_editor_loaded) return;

  const module = await import('./editor.js');
  module.initEditor();
  window.__gsmui_editor_loaded = true;
}
```

### 39.2 Debouncing

```js
// Conceptual debouncing (upstream)
function debounce(fn, delay) {
  let timeoutId;
  return function(...args) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => fn.apply(this, args), delay);
  };
}
```

### 39.3 Throttling

```js
// Conceptual throttling (upstream)
function throttle(fn, limit) {
  let inThrottle;
  return function(...args) {
    if (!inThrottle) {
      fn.apply(this, args);
      inThrottle = true;
      setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
    }
  };
}
```

### 39.4 Virtual Scrolling

For large lists, the bundle supports virtual scrolling:

```js
// Conceptual virtual scrolling (upstream)
function createVirtualList(container, items, renderItem) {
  const viewport = document.createElement('div');
  const content = document.createElement('div');

  container.style.overflow = 'auto';
  viewport.style.height = '100%';
  content.style.height = `${items.length * itemHeight}px`;

  container.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const start = Math.floor(container.scrollTop / itemHeight);
    const end = start + Math.ceil(container.clientHeight / itemHeight);

    content.innerHTML = '';
    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
      content.appendChild(renderItem(items[i], i));
    }
  });

  container.appendChild(viewport);
  viewport.appendChild(content);
}
```

### 40.3 Browser-Specific Workarounds

```js
// Conceptual browser detection (upstream)
const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
const isFirefox = typeof InstallTrigger !== 'undefined';

if (isSafari) {
  // Safari-specific workarounds
  document.documentElement.classList.add('browser-safari');
}

if (isFirefox) {
  // Firefox-specific workarounds
  document.documentElement.classList.add('browser-firefox');
}
```

### 44.2 Configuration Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `debug` | boolean | `false` | Enable debug logging |
| `analytics` | boolean | `false` | Enable usage analytics |
| `theme` | string | `'system'` | Initial theme |
| `locale` | string | `'en'` | Default locale |
| `reducedMotion` | boolean | `auto` | Override motion preference |
| `focusVisible` | boolean | `true` | Show focus-visible rings |

### 44.3 Environment Detection

```js
// Conceptual environment detection (upstream)
const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
const isDevelopment = !isProduction;

if (isDevelopment) {
  // Enable debug mode
  console.log('gsmui: Development mode');
}
```

## 45. Bundle Error Codes

### 45.1 Error Code Reference

| Code | Message | Cause | Solution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GSMUI-001` | Missing component type | `data-gsmui-component` attribute missing | Add attribute to element |
| `GSMUI-002` | Unknown component type | Invalid `data-gsmui-component` value | Check component name |
| `GSMUI-003` | Missing required mixin | Mixin not registered | Check bundle initialization |
| `GSMUI-004` | Invalid attribute value | Attribute value out of range | Check documentation |
| `GSMUI-005` | DOM mutation conflict | Concurrent DOM changes | Debounce mutations |
| `GSMUI-006` | CSS injection failed | `adoptedStyleSheets` not supported | Fallback to `<style>` |
| `GSMUI-007` | Observer disconnect failed | Observer already disconnected | Check cleanup logic |
| `GSMUI-008` | Event dispatch failed | Event target removed | Check element existence |

### 45.2 Error Handling Strategy

```js
// Conceptual error code system (upstream)
const ERROR_CODES = {
  MISSING_COMPONENT_TYPE: 'GSMUI-001',
  UNKNOWN_COMPONENT_TYPE: 'GSMUI-002',
  MISSING_MIXIN: 'GSMUI-003',
  INVALID_ATTRIBUTE: 'GSMUI-004',
  DOM_CONFLICT: 'GSMUI-005',
  CSS_INJECTION_FAILED: 'GSMUI-006',
  OBSERVER_DISCONNECT: 'GSMUI-007',
  EVENT_DISPATCH_FAILED: 'GSMUI-008',
};

function throwError(code, message) {
  const error = new Error(`[${code}] ${message}`);
  error.code = code;
  throw error;
}
```

### 46.2 Size Reduction Strategies

| Strategy | Savings | Tradeoff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tree shaking | 10–20% | Requires ESM import |
| Dead code elimination | 5–15% | Requires build analysis |
| Compression (gzip) | 60–70% | No tradeoff |
| Compression (brotli) | 70–80% | Server config required |
| Code splitting | 30–40% | Lazy load non-critical |

## 47. Bundle Documentation

### 47.1 README for Bundles

```markdown
# GsmUi Bundles

## Overview
This directory contains pre-built JS/CSS bundles for the GsmUi component library.
These files are produced by an upstream pipeline and committed as build artifacts.

## Files
- `gsmui.js` — Main component bundle (IIFE, self-hosted)
- `gsmui.module.js` — ES module variant
- `gsmui.min.js` — Minified production variant
- `editor.js` — Playground/Monaco editor bundle (lazy-loaded)
- `editor.css` — Editor-specific styles
- `editor.min.js` — Minified editor variant
- `manifest.json` — Asset map for host app integration
- `*.map` — Source maps for debugging

## Usage
1. Include `manifest.json` in your host app
2. Read bundle URLs from the manifest
3. Inject `<script>` tags with `defer` attribute
4. Use `adoptedStyleSheets` for dynamic CSS

## CSP Compliance
All bundles are self-hosted with zero external resources.
See `08.55-frontend-security.md` for CSP details.

## Versioning
Bundles use content-hashed filenames for cache busting.
See `08.51-build-pipeline.md` for versioning details.
```

## 49. Open Questions / Risks (Exhaustive Final)

- **HMR gap:** because `dist/` isn't built locally, JS behavior changes require an upstream rebuild. Confirm the turnaround path for JS-only fixes.
- **Manifest path coupling:** host apps must read `manifest.json` paths, not hardcode `/vendor/gsmui/dist/...`, to survive version bumps.
- **Tailwind v4 theme:** confirm the upstream build emits the `.dark` class variant consumed by `08.43`.
- **Source map hosting:** confirm that source maps are served from the same origin for CSP compliance.
- **Bundle size monitoring:** add automated bundle size checks to the upstream CI pipeline.
- **CSS extraction:** confirm that `editor.css` is extracted correctly and not inlined in the JS bundle.
- **Module compatibility:** verify that `gsmui.module.js` works with Vite, Rollup, and webpack.
- **Browser support matrix:** define the minimum browser versions supported by the bundles.
- **Service worker interaction:** if PWA is enabled (`08.48`), verify that service workers cache `dist/` files correctly.
- **Offline support:** confirm that `dist/` files can be cached by service workers for offline use.
- **Version skew:** if a host app has mixed versions of `gsmui.js` and `editor.js`, verify they are compatible.
- **Backward compatibility:** define the deprecation policy for bundle API changes.
- **Build reproducibility:** ensure that the upstream build is deterministic (same input → same output).
- **License compliance:** verify that all bundled dependencies have compatible licenses.
- **Security audit:** run a security scan on the bundles to detect vulnerabilities.
- **CSS variable injection:** confirm that all `--gsmui-*` variables are injected before component initialization.
- **Event system compatibility:** verify that custom events don't conflict with host app events.
- **Keyboard navigation:** confirm that all keyboard patterns match ARIA APG recommendations.
- **Reduced motion:** verify that `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.
- **Screen reader testing:** test bundles with VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS.
- **Performance regression:** add bundle size and load time checks to CI.
- **Release automation:** automate the release process to reduce human error.
- **Documentation updates:** ensure that bundle changes are reflected in the docs.
- **Migration guides:** provide upgrade guides for breaking bundle changes.
- **Deprecation warnings:** add console warnings for deprecated bundle APIs.
- **Bundle composition:** verify that no unused code is included in the bundles.
- **Tree shaking:** confirm that ESM module supports tree shaking in host app bundlers.
- **Code splitting:** verify that `editor.js` is properly code-split from `gsmui.js`.
- **Memory management:** verify that all observers and listeners are cleaned up on component removal.
- **Type safety:** ensure that JSDoc annotations and TypeScript declarations are complete.
- **Error codes:** document all error codes and their resolutions.
- **Configuration options:** document all runtime configuration options.
- **Size budgets:** enforce bundle size budgets in CI.
- **Compatibility testing:** test bundles across all supported browsers.
- **Accessibility testing:** verify bundles with screen readers and keyboard navigation.

## 50. Bundle Integration Checklist

### 50.1 Host App Integration Steps

| Step | Action | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Install package via Composer | `composer require gsmui/gsmui-pro` |
| 2 | Verify `dist/` exists | `ls vendor/gsmui/gsmui-pro/dist/` |
| 3 | Read `manifest.json` | Valid JSON with bundle URLs |
| 4 | Inject `<script>` tag for `gsmui.js` | Page loads without CSP errors |
| 5 | Verify components initialize | Components render correctly |
| 6 | Test `wire:model` binding | Livewire updates work |
| 7 | Test dark mode | `.dark` class toggles correctly |
| 8 | Test responsive | Components adapt to viewport |
| 9 | Run Playwright tests | All tests pass |
| 10 | Verify CSP header | `script-src 'self'` present |

### 50.2 Common Integration Mistakes

| Mistake | Symptom | Solution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hardcoded bundle paths | 404 on version bump | Read from `manifest.json` |
| Missing `defer` attribute | Blocking page render | Add `defer` to `<script>` tag |
| External CDN reference | CSP violation | Use self-hosted bundles |
| Missing `manifest.json` | Bundles not loaded | Verify file exists |
| Wrong MIME type | Script not executed | Configure web server |
| Missing `data-gsmui-component` | Components not initialized | Add attribute to root elements |
| Missing `wire:model` | No Livewire binding | Add `wire:model` to components |
| Missing `__()` for strings | Hardcoded English | Use `__()` in Blade templates |

---

## 51. Bundle Versioning Policy

### 51.1 Semantic Versioning

| Change Type | Version Bump | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| New component | Minor | 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 |
| New prop/feature | Minor | 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 |
| Bug fix | Patch | 1.0.0 → 1.0.1 |
| CSS class change | Patch | 1.0.0 → 1.0.1 |
| Breaking API change | Major | 1.0.0 → 2.0.0 |
| Bundle size increase > 10% | Minor | 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 |
| Bundle size decrease | Patch | 1.0.0 → 1.0.1 |

### 51.2 Deprecation Policy

| Phase | Duration | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Deprecated | 2 minor versions | Console warning + docs |
| Removed | Next major version | Error + migration guide |

### 51.3 Breaking Change Examples

| Change | Breaking? | Migration |
| --- | --- |---|
| New optional prop | No | None required |
| Changed default value | Possibly | Update usage if依赖 default |
| Renamed prop | Yes | Update prop name |
| Changed event name | Yes | Update event listener |
| Removed component | Yes | Use alternative component |
| Changed CSS classes | Yes | Update custom styles |

| Load time (3G) | < 500ms | > 400ms |
| Parse time | < 100ms | > 80ms |
| Execute time | < 50ms | > 40ms |

### 52.3 Alerting Rules

| Alert | Condition | Severity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Size regression | Bundle size increased > 5% | Warning |
| Size critical | Bundle size increased > 10% | Critical |
| CSP violation | External resource blocked | Critical |
| Init error rate | > 1% of page loads | Warning |
| Init error rate | > 5% of page loads | Critical |
| Performance regression | Load time > 2x baseline | Warning |
